blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — New Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon on Wednesday expressed his willingness to testify once again in future trials of former lawmaker Zaldy Co and other personalities implicated in flood control scandal. Dizon was asked if he would still take the witness stand before the Sandiganbayan if he is asked to do so even if he is no longer with the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH). READ: DPWH chief Dizon testifies in Sandiganbayan graft case vs Zaldy Co “Syempre, kung ano’ng kailangan sa atin ng Ombudsman gagawin natin kasi kailangan tuloy-tuloy na makulong sina Zaldy Co,” Dizon told […]...
